correctness.rationale: Write p=E11, n=E12, L=E11+E21, and W=(Fp+Fn) plus M2(F)omega. In the specified multiplication, p(a+b omega)=pa+(bp)omega and likewise for n. The first components have zero second row, and right multiplication of b by p or n fills the first or second column respectively; therefore pO+nO=W, and every Phi value lies in W. With y=A+B omega and x=L, the first component is pLA-nAL=(a11-a21-a22)p+a12 n. The second component is B(Lp-bar(L)n)=B times the matrix with rows (1,0) and (1,1). For any target sp+tn+C omega take A with first row (s,t) and zero second row, and B=C times the matrix with rows (1,0) and (-1,1). This constructs a preimage in the fixed slice over every allowed field. The six target coordinates are independent. The determinants of p,n,p+n vanish, proving the stated norm orthogonality, and p,n are independent nonzero zero divisors. Parentheses are kept as in Phi, without associativity of the octonion algebra. The frozen verifier and its determinant-one-minor output were inspected, not executed; this algebraic check does not rely on that run.
